AI assistant helping a content creator in Great Britain, removing words from a video—whether it is cutting out "ums" and "ahs," editing out conversational pauses, or deleting specific spoken phrases—has become vastly easier thanks to **Text-Based Video Editing**. 

Instead of traditional timeline chopping, modern AI tools allow you to edit a video simply by highlighting and deleting text in a transcript, automatically trimming the corresponding video and audio.

Here is a comprehensive guide to the best software tools, key industry options (including your specified tools), and an efficient workflow method tailored for creators.

---

### 1. Key Industry Software Options

#### **Descript** (The Gold Standard for Text-Based Editing)
* **Overview:** Descript pioneered AI-powered text-based video editing. When you import a video, it transcribes the audio. Deleting a word, sentence, or paragraph from the text automatically deletes it from the video timeline.
